description: This file contains utility functions for parsing HTTP request bodies, headers, query parameters, and path parameters within a FastAPI application. It includes functions for safely reading and caching request data, handling file size limits, converting form data and uploaded files, and extracting metadata tags.

methods.name: _read_request_body
methods.description: Safely reads and parses the request body as JSON, with error handling and caching.

methods.name: _safe_get_request_parsed_body
methods.description: Retrieves cached parsed body from request scope if available.

methods.name: _safe_get_request_query_params
methods.description: Safely retrieves query parameters from the request.

methods.name: _safe_set_request_parsed_body
methods.description: Caches the parsed request body into the request scope.

methods.name: _safe_get_request_headers
methods.description: Safely retrieves headers from the request.

methods.name: check_file_size_under_limit
methods.description: Checks if an uploaded file is within size limits based on deployment settings and user privileges.

methods.name: get_form_data
methods.description: Reads and parses form data from a request, handling special key formats.

methods.name: convert_upload_files_to_file_data
methods.description: Converts FastAPI UploadFile objects into tuples suitable for HTTP requests.

methods.name: get_request_body
methods.description: Determines request content type and parses body accordingly.

methods.name: get_tags_from_request_body
methods.description: Extracts tags from request body metadata and request data.

methods.name: populate_request_with_path_params
methods.description: Populates request data with path parameters, including extracting from URL if necessary.
